theme: Hybrid (Dark Navy Landing Page / High-Contrast Light Dashboard)

rules.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-none text-white

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle digital noise overlay on the dark navy sections to kill the 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal' variant (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10) for stats bar overlapping the hero.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary CTA in primary_orange (#ff6300) with hover state shifting to a lighter orange. Include hover micro-interactions (-translate-y-1 + shadow-lg).
visual_enhancers.cards: For the landing page: Bento grid styling using soft_sky tinted background (bg-[#5BC0EB]/10) with sharp 1px borders. For Admin: Flat crisp white, minimal shadow, 1px subtle border.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with Duotone weight for premium feel.

motion_and_interactions.hero_animation: Kinetic masked line-by-line reveal for the H1 headline using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Staggered fade-up for bento grid cards and 'Tentang Kami' list items using framer-motion 'whileInView'.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle vertical parallax translation on the hero image via Framer Motion useScroll.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow, editorial drift (react-fast-marquee). High-contrast typography running seamlessly in the background of the 'Program' section.

landing_page.navbar: Glassmorphic fixed header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#172B4D]/80). Do not use fully transparent. Links visible on desktop.
landing_page.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Text content (H1 + Subtitle + CTA) taking 7 columns left, overlapping parallax hero image on the right. Deep Navy (#172B4D) to Darker Navy (#0B1526) gradient.
landing_page.stats_bar: Overlapping the bottom edge of the hero section. Grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4. Glassmorphism panel.
landing_page.program_section: Bento Grid layout (Mode A). Mixed span logic for SD, SMP, SMA/UTBK, Bahasa Asing. Cards should utilize bg-[#5BC0EB]/10.
landing_page.tentang_kami: Split 50/50. Left: Full height image with subtle rounded corners. Right: Numbered manifesto checkpoints.
landing_page.pengajar: Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8. Cards with photo, name, subject, and credentials.
landing_page.paket_pertemuan: 4 column layout (2x, 4x, 6x, 8x). Highlight the 6x/8x as 'Terpopuler' using accent_yellow (#fae903).
landing_page.faq: Accordion list via Shadcn UI, customized to match brand fonts.
landing_page.registration: Two-column grid layout for the form, leading to a WhatsApp CTA button.

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar-based navigation (Left edge, Collapsible). Topbar for breadcrumbs and user profile.
admin_dashboard.sidebar: Deep Navy (#172B4D) with white text. Active state highlighted with Orange (#ff6300).
admin_dashboard.content_area: Light theme (bg-[#F8FAFC]). Crisp tables, Shadcn Select/Inputs. Progressive disclosure.
admin_dashboard.tables: Dense data tables for Tutors, Packages, Registrations. Right-aligned action menus.

component_instructions.forms: Use pure Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Textarea components. Customize focus rings to #ff6300.
component_instructions.dialog: Use Shadcn Dialog for edit/create actions in the Admin dashboard.
component_instructions.toasts: Use Sonner for toast notifications (success/error messages in admin/forms).

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: You MUST use modern JS, this is a .js not a .tsx codebase, so ensure your imports and component files don't use TypeScript types.
Never center text by default. Left-align text for readability, particularly inside grids and bento layouts.
Use generous padding. E.g. p-8 or p-12 for bento grid cards.
All interactive elements MUST have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
No complete transparent backgrounds. Even subtle glassmorphism must have a backdrop-blur + color tint.
Hover states must be obvious and accessible. Use transitions on specific properties, NOT 'transition-all'.
Respect contrast ratios. Light text on the Dark Navy background, Dark text on the Sky Blue / Yellow accents.
Use the layout grid to create intentional asymmetry (Tension = Interest).
